lengthWeight.source: FishBase LWR table: Caribbean coast of Colombia, 2012-2013, TL, 12.6-102 cm (no US entries; the Cuban entry is fork length)

growth.source: FishBase growth table: southwest Florida (Linf in fork length). Max age: oldest sampled fish, an 18-year-old Atlantic-coast female (Florida Museum).

spawn.notes: Spawning aggregations at passes and river mouths May-September (FishBase). Temperature range is an estimate inside FishBase's 25-31 C.

migration.notes: Cold-intolerant: moves up rivers and into warm springs during cold snaps; adults die at about 6-12 C (Florida Museum).

markings.where: the lateral line, from the gill cover to the tail fork
markings.notes: a distinct black line, the snook's signature

pattern.fins: pelvic fins pale yellow; two separate dorsal fins; forked tail; long sloping snout with a jutting lower jaw; razor-edged gill covers

variants.spawning_male: pelvic and tail fins turn noticeably more yellow at spawning (both sexes)
variants.juvenile: juvenile colours not described in the sources used; keep the black lateral line

pattern.source: Florida Museum of Natural History common snook profile; FishBase (black lateral line)

regulations.notes: Gulf coast (Big Bend region): slot 28-33 in total length, 1 per harvester per day, open March-April and September-November. Snatch hooks and spearing prohibited. Gamefish since 1957: sale banned. These rules apply in fresh water too.

economy.notes: Excellent food fish, but sale has been banned in Florida since 1957.

facts: Snook start life as males and many later turn female, so nearly all the biggest snook are females.
Cold kills snook: adults die at about 6-12 C, which is why they crowd into warm springs during cold snaps.
Florida declared the snook a gamefish in 1957 and banned its sale.

research.task: Catch one under a dock light at night
Find snook sheltering in the Spring Run during a cold snap

ledger.wrenNote: Snook face into the current and wait at the edge of the shade. Cast up-tide, let the bait swing past the piling, and when he takes it, turn his head right now or those gill plates will cut you off.
